title: tasks.task_changed v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the tasks module when a task is made or changed; the attention module projects it into its assignee's queue, and the calendar's Due layer will read it. Ids, enums, dates and times only, never a title, an address or an amount. `revision` grows with every change of one task: apply only newer ones. Workspace-scoped; also listed in openapi/events.json.

due_at.description: The time it is due, when it has one; `due_on` is its local day.

later_until.description: When Later ends, for a `later` plan.

handed_by.description: The member who handed it to the assignee, while it is handed off.

previous_assignee.description: For a hand-off or a take-back, the member who had it before.

previous_handed_by.description: For a hand-off or a take-back, the member who had handed it off before.

source.description: The record it came from, or null.
